entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand you sold me is a piece of garbage. The pulse tracker is completely useless. I want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your device. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the pulse sensor or a preference issue?
It's a fault! It's garbage! The readings are all over the place. I don't have time to play games with this thing. I just want my money back.
I certainly understand your frustration. Sometimes a simple software reset can recalibrate the sensor. If you have a moment, we could try—

No! I'm not doing your job for you. I paid for a working product, not a project. I am done with it. I want a refund now. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager and write a review about this scam on every website I can find?
Okay, I understand. I won't ask you to troubleshoot. Let me just pull up your order to check the return eligibility. Can I have your order number?
It's VF-987654321. Just get it done.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered 31 days ago.
Let me just check our official return policy here... Yes, according to my system, items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery.
Since you are well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on file right now.
Finally. See how easy that was? You should have just done that in the first place. Make sure that email comes through.
It's on its way. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued within 5-7 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
